atoms.b: Shadows are formed when ((++an__opaque a_transparent)) object blocks light’s path.
Shadows are ((++the_same a_different)) shape as the object that causes them.
Can objects have more than one shadow?
Yes, objects can have more than one shadow if they are blocking more than one ((++light_source object)).
A shadow of an object will move depending on the ((++angle size)) of the light source to the object.
As the sun moves over the course of the day, the shadow of an object caused by the sun moves too. When the sun is more overhead, the shadow is ((++smaller larger)).
When the sun is nearer to the horizon, the shadow is ((++larger smaller)).
